channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbusinessAndMarket, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Rhode Island governor rematch heats up with accusations of opioid ties, nepotism, and outsider claims
item.description: Helena Foulkes has outraised Governor Dan McKee and uses his handling of a $571 million bridge project as a key attack line. McKee defeated her four years ago.

item.title: Dolly Parton's Nashville strategy: using humor to flip gender roles
item.description: Through songs like "Dumb Blonde" and a lively 1973 duet with Porter Wagoner, Parton used self-deprecating wit to challenge traditional expectations.

item.title: Spider-Man's $2.4 billion haul leads Hollywood's best summer since pandemic
item.description: "Spider-Man: Brand New Day" also became only the second film this decade to top the box office for six consecutive weeks.

item.title: Trump's Canada tariffs hit swing states ahead of midterms
item.description: A rarely used trade law targets Wisconsin cheese, Maine seafood, and Kentucky appliances. Canada's PM says the move aims to cripple its auto industry.
